'''Lem''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] soldier of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3640 BBY]] he was stationed on [[Voss]], where took an incursion into the [[Nightmare Lands]], which left him completely mad and unable to communicate. However, Lem was still alive and conscious, which prompted [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Olkav]] to use him as a test subject for the vaccine he was developing.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lem appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the mission "Tapping Corruption" on Voss.
